title: VPN disconnects every 10 minutes when working from home
description: User reports the Acme VPN client connects fine but drops every 8-10 minutes. Home broadband, Windows 11 laptop. Reconnecting works but drops again.
resolution: Home router had aggressive UDP session timeout. Switched VPN client transport from UDP to TCP (Settings > Connection > Protocol: TCP) and disabled Wi-Fi power saving in Device Manager. Connection stable for 3 hours afterwards.

title: VPN error 'Authentication failed' after password change
description: User changed their AD password yesterday. Now Acme VPN shows 'Authentication failed (code 691)'. Laptop login with new password works.
resolution: VPN client had the old password cached. Cleared saved credentials in the VPN client (Settings > Account > Forget saved credentials) and signed in with the new password plus MFA push. Connected successfully.

title: Cannot reach internal sites over VPN but internet works
description: VPN shows Connected but intranet.acme.local and the HR portal do not load. Public websites work.
resolution: DNS was resolving through the home router instead of the VPN adapter. Ran 'ipconfig /flushdns', then disconnected/reconnected VPN. Also set the VPN adapter interface metric lower than Wi-Fi. Internal sites now resolve.

title: Account locked out after too many login attempts
description: User locked out of Windows and Outlook. Says they typed the password correctly. Lockout recurs every morning.
resolution: Old password was saved on the user's phone mail app, which kept retrying and locking the account. Unlocked account in AD, removed and re-added the work account on the phone with the new password. No lockouts since.

title: Forgot password, not on office network
description: User forgot password while travelling. Cannot log in to laptop or VPN.
resolution: Guided user to the Self-Service Password Reset portal (https://passwordreset.acme.example) from their phone. Verified with Authenticator app and reset password. At the laptop login screen, used 'Sign in to another network' option to connect to hotel Wi-Fi, then logged in with new password and connected VPN to sync credentials.

title: New phone - MFA prompts going to old phone
description: User got a new phone and wiped the old one. MFA approval requests still go to the old device. Cannot sign in to Microsoft 365.
resolution: Verified user identity via manager callback. Revoked existing MFA methods in the Entra admin portal and required re-registration. User signed in at https://aka.ms/mfasetup and registered the Authenticator app on the new phone.

title: Not receiving MFA push notifications
description: Authenticator app is installed but push notifications never arrive. User has to open the app manually.
resolution: Battery optimisation on Android was blocking background notifications for Authenticator. Disabled battery optimisation for the app and enabled notifications. As fallback, user can enter the 6-digit code from the app instead of approving a push.

title: Outlook stuck on 'Loading Profile'
description: Outlook desktop hangs at 'Loading Profile' splash screen. Web Outlook works fine.
resolution: Started Outlook in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe) which loaded; a third-party PDF add-in was the cause. Disabled the add-in via File > Options > Add-ins > COM Add-ins. Outlook starts normally now.

title: Mailbox full - cannot send emails
description: User receives 'Your mailbox is full' warning and cannot send. Mailbox shows 49.8 GB of 50 GB.
resolution: Enabled online archive for the user (Exchange admin) and applied the 2-year archive policy. Showed user how to empty Deleted Items and Sort by Size to remove large attachments. Mailbox dropped to 31 GB after archive ran.

title: Outlook search not returning recent emails
description: Searching in Outlook does not find emails from the last two weeks, older emails are found.
resolution: Windows Search index was corrupted. Rebuilt the index via Control Panel > Indexing Options > Advanced > Rebuild. Search returned correct results after indexing completed (~40 min).

title: Shared mailbox not showing in Outlook
description: User was granted access to finance-invoices@acme.example yesterday but it does not appear in Outlook.
resolution: Auto-mapping can take up to 60 minutes and requires an Outlook restart. Since it still did not appear, added it manually: File > Account Settings > Change > More Settings > Advanced > Add. Shared mailbox now visible.

title: Printer on 3rd floor shows offline
description: Printer PRN-3F-01 shows Offline for several users. Printer display shows it is ready.
resolution: Printer had picked up a new DHCP address after a power cut. Set a DHCP reservation for the printer MAC address and updated the port on the print server. Users can print again.

title: Print jobs stuck in queue
description: Documents sit in the print queue with status 'Printing' but nothing comes out. Cannot cancel them.
resolution: Restarted the Print Spooler service (services.msc > Print Spooler > Restart) after clearing C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS. Queue cleared and new jobs print normally.

title: How to add the office printer on a new laptop
description: New joiner needs to print but no printers are listed.
resolution: Pointed user to the Follow-Me printing queue. In File Explorer typed \\print01.acme.local, double-clicked 'FollowMe-Mono'. Jobs are released at any printer by tapping the badge.

title: Laptop very slow after Windows update
description: Since last night's update the laptop takes 10 minutes to boot and apps freeze. Disk at 100% in Task Manager.
resolution: Update was still finishing in background (TiWorker) and OneDrive was re-syncing 40k files. Let update complete, paused OneDrive sync for 2 hours, and ran Disk Cleanup with 'Windows Update Cleanup'. Performance back to normal after one restart.

title: External monitor not detected via docking station
description: USB-C dock charges the laptop but the two external monitors stay black.
resolution: Dock firmware and DisplayLink driver were outdated. Installed latest dock firmware from the Software Center and rebooted. Both monitors detected. Also advised using the USB-C port marked with the DisplayPort/Thunderbolt icon.

title: Laptop battery drains within 2 hours
description: Battery used to last a full day, now only 2 hours.
resolution: Battery report (powercfg /batteryreport) showed design capacity 56 Wh, full charge capacity 19 Wh. Battery worn out. Raised hardware replacement with vendor under warranty; battery replaced on-site.

title: Spilled coffee on laptop keyboard
description: User spilled coffee on laptop, some keys not working. Laptop still powers on.
resolution: Advised user to power off immediately and not to charge. Issued a loaner laptop from the IT bar and restored user's OneDrive data. Damaged laptop sent for repair under accidental damage cover.

title: Request to install Python on work laptop
description: User needs Python 3 for data analysis. Install fails with 'requires administrator'.
resolution: Python 3.12 is available in the Software Center (self-service, no admin needed). Showed user how to install it from Software Center > Applications > Python. Additional packages can be installed with 'pip install --user'.

title: Software not available in Software Center
description: User needs a diagram tool that is not in the Software Center.
resolution: Non-catalogue software requires a Software Request form with manager approval and a security review. Raised request REQ-5521; security approved and packaging team added the tool to Software Center within 3 working days.

title: Microsoft Teams camera not working
description: In Teams meetings the camera shows a black screen. Camera works in the Windows Camera app.
resolution: Windows privacy setting blocked desktop apps from accessing the camera. Enabled Settings > Privacy & security > Camera > 'Let desktop apps access your camera'. Then selected correct camera in Teams > Settings > Devices.

title: Teams keeps showing user as 'Away'
description: Teams status changes to Away after 5 minutes even while user is working in other apps.
resolution: Status changes to Away after 5 min of system inactivity or when the PC locks. Advised user to set status duration (Status > Duration > Available, 1 day). Explained this is by design and not a fault.

title: Teams audio echo in meetings
description: Other participants hear echo whenever the user speaks.
resolution: User was using laptop speakers and external webcam microphone simultaneously. Switched to the company-issued headset and set it as both speaker and microphone in Teams device settings. Echo gone.

title: OneDrive sync stuck 'Processing changes'
description: OneDrive icon shows sync pending for two days. Files are not appearing on other devices.
resolution: A file with a path longer than 400 characters and a file name containing '#' blocked sync. Renamed the file and shortened the folder path. Then reset OneDrive (onedrive.exe /reset). Sync completed.

title: Accidentally deleted folder on shared drive
description: User deleted the 'Q2 Reports' folder from the Finance shared drive (S:).
resolution: Restored the folder using Previous Versions (right-click parent folder > Properties > Previous Versions) from the 12:00 snapshot. Shared drive snapshots are taken every 4 hours and retained for 30 days.

title: Access denied to Finance shared folder
description: User moved to the Finance team and needs access to \\fs01\Finance.
resolution: Access to shared folders is managed via AD groups and requires data-owner approval. Raised access request in the Access Portal for group 'FS-Finance-RW'; approved by Finance data owner. User logged off/on to refresh group membership.

title: Wi-Fi 'Acme-Corp' connected, no internet
description: Laptop connects to Acme-Corp Wi-Fi but shows 'No internet, secured'. Colleagues are fine.
resolution: Laptop's machine certificate had expired, so 802.1X placed it in a quarantine VLAN. Connected to wired network, ran 'gpupdate /force' and 'certutil -pulse' to renew certificate. Wi-Fi working after reboot.

title: Guest Wi-Fi access for visitor
description: Visitor needs internet access for a workshop today.
resolution: Host employee created a guest pass from the Guest Wi-Fi portal (valid 24h). Visitor connected to 'Acme-Guest' and entered the code. Guest network is internet-only, no access to internal resources.

title: New joiner laptop setup - cannot log in first time
description: New starter cannot log into their laptop on day one. Error: 'The sign-in method you are trying to use isn't allowed'.
resolution: Account was still in the 'Pre-start' OU with logon disabled until start date. HR start date had been entered incorrectly. Corrected the start date, moved account to the Users OU, and the user set their password via the temporary access pass.

title: Suspicious email asking to verify payroll details
description: User received an email appearing to be from HR asking to log in and confirm bank details. User clicked the link but did not enter details.
resolution: Confirmed phishing. Security team purged the email from all mailboxes and blocked the sender domain. As user clicked the link, forced a password reset and revoked active sessions as a precaution. User reminded to use the 'Report Phishing' button in Outlook.

title: Laptop lost at airport
description: User left their work laptop at airport security and could not recover it.
resolution: Issued remote lock and wipe via Intune. Confirmed BitLocker encryption was enabled. Disabled device in Entra ID and reset the user's password. Ordered replacement laptop; user to file a police report for insurance.

title: BitLocker recovery key prompt on startup
description: Laptop asks for a 48-digit BitLocker recovery key after a BIOS update.
resolution: Verified user identity and retrieved the recovery key from Entra ID (Devices > BitLocker keys) using the Key ID shown on screen. After unlock, suspended and resumed BitLocker protection so it would not prompt again.

title: VPN client will not install on Mac
description: On macOS the Acme VPN installer finishes but the client shows 'System extension blocked'.
resolution: macOS requires approving the system extension. Opened System Settings > Privacy & Security, clicked 'Allow' for the Acme VPN extension, and restarted. Client connected normally.

title: Excel crashes when opening large file
description: Excel freezes and closes when opening a 300 MB workbook.
resolution: User had 32-bit Office installed which is limited to ~2 GB memory. Replaced with 64-bit Microsoft 365 Apps from Software Center. Also disabled hardware graphics acceleration. Workbook opens fine.

title: VPN slow when on video calls
description: Teams calls are choppy only when VPN is connected.
